chunks: So I ran away from you out of fear. But my Lord has given me wisdom, and made me an apostle.
ai.seo_question: What did God grant Hud after he fled from his people?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse is part of Prophet Hud's dialogue with his people, illustrating the transition from human vulnerability to divine empowerment. Shia exegesis emphasizes that 'Hukm' (judgment/wisdom) here signifies both prophetic authority and the ability to discern truth, marking his elevation to the rank of 'Mursalun' (those sent with a specific mission). This narrative serves as a paradigm for the Imams, who similarly navigate societal hostility while relying on divinely granted knowledge and authority.
